thread:
oncall-bot: ALERT: high error rate and increased latency observed during a cross-region traffic-shift. Paging on-call: @lee. Incident severity: P1 (auto-detected). 

sam: seeing the same — spikes in 3 AZs in eu-west and partial failover to us-west2. Some requests are still hitting eu-central despite traffic-shift policy.

lee: ACK. joining. pulling up traffic-shift job. any recent deploys?

maria: no deploys in last 30m. Alert correlation: BGP egress metrics show packet drops in eu-west-2 AZ B; DNS health checks are flapping for the regional egress LB.

ajay: copying runbook: https://confluence.internal/runbooks/traffic-shift-failover. Steps 1-3 show conditional rollback.

lee: running quick sanity: `curl -I https://health.redwood.example/status` from eu-west-2 -> 502 intermittently. From us-west2 -> 200.

sam: route53 records for router-redwood-eu are showing mixed weight states: some edges still returning old IPs. Propagation seems slow.

kate: support-bot reports ~1200 affected requests/min to hosted API from EU customers, errors ~8%. Tagging customer-impact.

lee: immediate mitigation plan: 1) pause traffic-shift job, 2) force drain on eu-west-2 hosts with suspected egress issue, 3) if drain stalls, rollback routing to pre-shift config. I'll coordinate.

maria: ops note — AZ B egress instances show kernel drops and NIC offloads toggling. Possibly a host-level firmware bug triggered by drain traffic pattern. Eng-infra paging next.

oncall-bot: @eng-infra has been paged for network egress anomaly in eu-west-2.

eng-infra (sam): I'm on it, SSHing to the host pool and checking NIC stats. Running `ethtool -S` and overlay logs now.

sam: ethtool shows tx_errors on several instances. kube-proxy logs show connection resets during KV syncs.

lee: can we move traffic to eu-west-1 and eu-central while we triage? That keeps latency low for EU customers.

ajay: we need to be careful: weighted routing already redirected a portion; shifting more may overload the remaining AZs. Check current CPU/GPU utilization on eu-west-1.

maria: eu-west-1 headroom ~35% for API gateways. We can absorb a partial shift but not full. Recommend a staged move 20% -> 40%.

lee: executing staged reroute via infra CLI. Command:```infra traffic-shift --policy staged --from eu-west-2 --to eu-west-1,eu-central --weights 20,20 --dry-run=false```

deploy-bot: traffic-shift job 472901 started by lee at 4751123450. Monitoring metrics and health-check windows.

sam: while shift is running, I'm troubleshooting NIC firmware with infra. Found recent kernel driver updates rolled out 2 days ago to a subset of eu-west-2 hosts. Rolling those back on the flagged pool.

kate: support: opening an incident banner for affected EU customers. Messaging low-level outages and degraded performance.

lee: shift to eu-west-1=20% and eu-central=20% applied. Observing endpoints: error rate dropped to 4% within 3m. Latency trending down.

maria: great. however, drain on several eu-west-2 nodes is stuck in Terminating state — kubelet shows `eviction timeout` and connections stuck in TIME_WAIT. That could prevent full capacity recovery.

sam: manual cordon and `kubectl delete pod --grace-period=0 --force` on 6 stuck pods. Monitor for any cascading failures.

ajay: just flagging that force-delete can break in-flight requests; we already saw errors. But if they're stuck and causing resource contention, it's needed.

lee: approved. Proceed.

support-bot: customer-impact dashboard updated: top 5 customers with highest error volumes: cust-alpha, cust-gamma, cust-delta. Notified their CSMs.

lee: handoff note for next oncall: incident currently in mitigation. eu-west-2 egress hardware issue identified; staged traffic shift applied (40% total) to eu-west-1 and eu-central. Some nodes force-terminated. Root cause suspected driver/firmware regression. Eng-infra owning hardware rollback and host validation. Eng-runtime monitoring token-level errors, Redwood-Optimize flagged increased cost for retried tokens.

maria: additional telemetry: Route53 health check TTLs appear to be honored but some caches upstream: edge locations continued to serve stale DNS for ~120s leading to split-brain traffic until staged shift reached 40%. We'll put a note in postmortem.

lee: creating incident incident/4751122334 in PagerDuty, assigning P1. Running communications: SRE sync in 15m.

sam: eng-infra confirms firmware rollback on 8 hosts completed; NIC tx_errors cleared on those. Re-running health checks.

lee: after rollback and staged shift, errors at 0.8% and latency normal. Marking mitigation successful.

kate: drafting customer update: short outage for some EU customers during traffic shift; no data loss; mitigation performed. Will send after you approve.

ajay: next actions for postmortem: 1) scope hosts with recent driver update, 2) add egress drain checks into traffic-shift runbook, 3) add fail-closed routing step if DNS caches persist beyond N seconds.

lee: agreed. Also suggest adding a pre-shift probe to simulate heavy drain on a small subset to surface driver regressions.

oncall-bot: Handoff — lee is handing off to maria for overnight monitoring. Next update due in 1h unless changes.

maria: taking over. I'll watch the leaderboard, keep support informed, and start the postmortem doc.

sam: closing note: good coordination. recommend we publish the runbook changes and schedule a follow-up with infra to prevent future firmware-related partial failovers. :thumbsup:

support-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated -> monitoring. Logged timeline and primary actions to incident/4751122334.

lee: final — add retrospective meeting invite tomorrow 10am UTC.

maria: ack.
